about: The file naming pattern's tokens as a run fills them in. The app compiles the Settings pattern into a run's save template with these placeholders (packages/skotiq_core/lib/src/models/imaging/naming_pattern.dart, NamingToken.runPlaceholder) and files a frame with no filter or no target under these labels; the sequencer resolves the placeholders from its variable catalog and uses the same labels (sequencer/src/expressions/resolver.rs NO_FILTER_LABEL, NO_TARGET_LABEL; node/instructions/expose.rs calibration_target_label). Both sides test against this file.
